sources.notes: Official Diocese app containing prayer books in English, Coptic, and Arabic. ECB will use it as a current-practice and structure reference, but will not bulk-copy full prayer-book text without explicit republication permission.

sources.name: Katameros API
sources.notes: ECB uses the API to obtain daily reading structure and passage references. Returned third-party Bible text is not copied into ECB; ECB resolves Scripture to its own translation when available.

sources.name: Coptic SCRIPTORIUM — sahidica.mark
sources.notes: Used for the Sahidic Mark witness currently displayed in the parallel ECB reader, with source attribution.

importRules: Every liturgical text must record sourceId, source locator/version, language, review status, and rights status.
Daily lectionary data should store references separately from Bible wording.
When ECB has translated a referenced Bible passage, display the ECB text instead of importing an external Bible translation.
Do not bulk-copy official prayer-book wording until republication rights are documented.
Variants between current-practice sources and historical printed witnesses must be retained as provenance rather than silently normalized.
